description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105) capped at 19999, removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Haste], [Last Stand], [High Quick Cast 2], and [Natural Cure: Vanille] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Vanille] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Vanille
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for White Magic or Support abilities, White Magic or Support abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Vanille after using a White Magic or Support ability, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Vanille
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (2000)] to all allies, and grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies every other cast

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Natural Cure: Vanille
description.text: Grants [HP Stock (6000)] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
